title: PAP Therapy Equipment Rental Agreement Clause — The Rental Cap and Title
content:
# The Rental Cap and Title — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Clause 1 — Title.** Title to a rented PAP Therapy Equipment device passes to the patient once the paid months of the current rental period reach the coverage class's capped rental months. The paid months of the current period are the months paid under the current coverage on or after the rental period start date, less any of those months that a reversal has taken back.

**Clause 2 — Ownership date.** The ownership date is the day after the last day of the final paid month — the day its next month would have started.

**Clause 3 — Months beyond the cap.** A month beyond the cap is never billed, and one billed in error is denied with the denial reason "cap reached" and never charged to the patient.

**Clause 4 — What counts.** Months paid under an earlier coverage or an earlier rental period do not count toward the cap.

**Clause 5 — After title passes.** After title passes the device is the patient's property: it is never picked up, and its repairs follow the repair responsibility rules of PAP Therapy Equipment.

## Counting toward the cap

| Paid month | Counts toward the cap |
|---|---|
| paid under the current coverage in the current rental period, not reversed | yes |
| paid under the current coverage in the current rental period, later reversed | no |
| paid under an earlier coverage | no |
| paid in an earlier rental period | no |

## Worked example (hypothetical cap of 13 months)

A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) rental period started on 10 January of one year. Month 13 starts on 10 January of the next year and is paid; with no reversal, the paid months now reach 13. Month 13 would have been followed by a month starting 10 February, so the ownership date is 10 February and title passes on it. A fourteenth month billed in error would be denied as "cap reached" and not charged to the patient.
